scope: Actual iOS authoritative partition writes/reads, encrypted bounded frames, stable sealed namespace, immutable snapshots, resumable migration, snapshot-leased whole-dead partition retirement and verified bounded release of retained legacy references. Bulk transaction optimization and periodic idle maintenance remain incomplete; native fixtures not executed.

productionFiles.name: AgentKnowledgeDatabase
productionFiles.disposition: New writes and snapshot-aware reads use primary references; retain old formats when no primary reference exists; do not fall back after primary corruption

productionFiles.name: KnowledgePayloadMigration
productionFiles.disposition: Old inline/per-file reads remain; migration retains old external references until snapshot-exclusive paged verification releases them. Legacy physical file cleanup takes the same lease, preserves the original age/reference rules and skips nonregular/symlink entries

productionFiles.name: KnowledgePayloadWork
productionFiles.disposition: Actual coordinator startup starts a weak serial utility worker: eight-record migration, eight-record verified legacy release, eight-partition retirement, sixteen-candidate legacy file pages; busy leases defer five seconds. Periodic idle scheduling remains unported; no Android WorkManager or OS background guarantee

productionFiles.name: KnowledgePrimaryFrameCodec
productionFiles.disposition: Native byte-frame ZLIB/raw codec with bounded expansion and AEAD; internal format is not Android GZIP or a wire format

productionFiles.name: KnowledgePrimaryMigration
productionFiles.disposition: One catalog write transaction per page, verify staged complete plaintext before sentinel/cursor publication, preserve logical/vector state

productionFiles.name: KnowledgePrimaryPartitions
productionFiles.disposition: Four HMAC-key buckets, approximately 64 MiB/65536 appended-record targets, max four writer connections and one serialized reader per store; physical frames commit before catalog publication; per-record commit batching not yet optimized

productionFiles.name: KnowledgePrimaryReclaim
productionFiles.disposition: Bounded whole-dead partition retirement under nonblocking cross-process exclusive flock, lifetime/read-snapshot shared leases, durable queue committed before anchored validated unlink, retry after interruption. The same lease protects verified legacy reference release and age-gated legacy file cleanup; no primary orphan discovery or mixed-live compaction

productionFiles.name: KnowledgePrimarySchema
productionFiles.disposition: Native authenticated namespace/reference tables, bucket rotation/index, delete trigger, durable retirement queue, migration and legacy-reference release cursors; source/FTS/vector schemas retained
